protocol: Full 30s warm-up/120s measured workload, original dataset, concurrency, hashing, deadlines and acceptance checks. Each workload ran alone. Profiling adds diagnostic overhead and cannot supply final-artifact performance acceptance.

hashOnly.behavior: Twelve sequential bursts, each four concurrent real scrypt derivations with N=32768, r=8, p=1, keylen=32, maxmem=67108864. Samples RSS every10ms without forced GC/heap flags. Synthetic strings; no credentials.
hashOnly.limits: Not application workload acceptance, an exact native allocation decomposition or proof of a hashing leak.

sourceProfile.instrumentation: Ten-second process.memoryUsage/getHeapStatistics samples in the owned workload observer, in addition to original10ms RSS sampling. All production files initially exact main.
sourceProfile.conclusion: Large heap expansion with much lower live heap in a later sample is observed. No demonstrated unbounded live-object leak or exact attribution of all RSS.

transactionDispatcher.source: Uninstalled finite statements and emitted JavaScript candidate plus a WeakMap keyed by Db, retaining one db.transaction(operation => operation()).immediate dispatcher per connection. Each invocation passes the current synchronous closure, retaining both original deadline checks and the driver's original rollback/savepoint handling.
transactionDispatcher.disposition: Rejected as a memory fix and removed from scratch before subsequent candidates. Not installed or accepted on the strength of one passing hash/busy observation.

allocationProfile.source: Finite-statement source plus the scratch transaction dispatcher; no emitted-code launch. node:inspector HeapProfiler sampling at32768 bytes includes allocations collected by minor/major GC. No forced GC or heap limit change.
allocationProfile.observations: Sampled cumulative allocation attributed82460824 bytes to the list-route frame,43714920 to Helmet parseDirectives and15973104 to its middleware-construction frame; many other Fastify/socket/DTO/authority frames contribute. These are sampled cumulative allocations, not retained heap or independently additive exact RSS.
allocationProfile.disposition: Diagnostic only; no external inspector listener, raw profile publication or acceptance claim.

defaultHeaderCompilation.source: Restore original writeTx and observer. With finite statements/emitted JavaScript, register the existing Fastify Helmet plugin global:false; build the existing locked transitive Helmet default middleware once, apply it only when actual route config has no helmet override; let the plugin retain route override/decorator behavior. Guard metadata type and propagate middleware errors. No main/manifest/lockfile edit.
defaultHeaderCompilation.disposition: Rejected and original app restored. Existing tests are not full security-header/override equivalence, and a production direct import would need its own reviewed explicit dependency/build contract.

bundledApi.source: Original app/header policy and writeTx plus finite statements. Workspace's existing esbuild produces a scratch ESM API for node22.12 with better-sqlite3 external and createRequire banner. Output under the platform directory preserves the current relative migration path. Emitted workload imports this actual API entry. No runtime bundler/dependency or production build mechanism installed.
bundledApi.disposition: Rejected. Bundling did not solve acceptance; successful launch is not complete packaged-runtime/module/path equivalence.

scope.disposition: Distinct experiments rejected; do not keep repeating equivalent candidates or treat a failed optimization as a completed plan item. Further replacement design and final supported-runtime acceptance remain required.
